Name: Operating checking
Notes: Customer payments and most bills

Name: Payroll checking
Notes: Optional. Funded from operating before each pay run

Name: Accounts receivable
Notes: Progress bills due now, net of retainage

Name: Retainage receivable
Notes: Part of each progress bill the customer holds back until closeout, often 5% or 10%

Name: Costs and estimated earnings in excess of billings
Notes: Underbillings from the month-end WIP schedule: earned but not yet billed

Name: Prepaid insurance
Notes: Liability, auto and bonding premiums paid ahead

Name: Trucks and vehicles
Notes: At cost

Name: Equipment
Notes: Owned equipment at cost; rented equipment is a job cost instead

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Supplier and sub invoices, net of retainage held

Name: Retainage payable
Notes: Amounts held back from subs, paid when the job closes

Name: Billings in excess of costs and estimated earnings
Notes: Overbillings from the month-end WIP schedule: billed but not yet earned

Name: Sales tax payable
Notes: Where your state taxes materials or services

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll register

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Equipment loans
Notes: Split each payment between this line and interest expense

Name: Contract revenue
Notes: Progress bills on contracts, including retainage. The WIP adjustment for over and under billings also posts here

Name: Change orders
Notes: Kept apart to show how much of the year came from extras

Name: Service and small jobs
Notes: Time and materials work outside a contract

Name: Direct labor
Notes: Field wages for hours on jobs, matching the labor line of the estimate

Name: Materials
Notes: Materials bought for a specific job

Name: Subcontractors
Notes: Sub invoices, gross of retainage held. Collect a W-9 before the first payment

Name: Equipment rental and fuel
Notes: Rented equipment and fuel used on jobs

Name: Office wages
Notes: Office and estimating staff

Name: Payroll taxes and benefits
Notes: Move the field share to 5010 if you want burdened labor in job costs

Name: Vehicle costs
Notes: Trucks used across jobs: fuel, repairs, registration

Name: Insurance
Notes: General liability, workers' compensation, auto

Name: Software
Notes: Estimating, project management and accounting

Name: Small tools
Notes: Tools below the capitalization threshold

Name: Interest expense
Notes: Interest part of equipment loan payments
